text: Trading Volume is the U.S. dollar equivalent of spot matched trades between buyers and sellers through Coinbase during the measurement period. It excludes derivatives volume and trades executed on third-party venues. Derivatives transaction revenue is recorded in consumer and institutional transaction revenue.
